purpose: Stage Elite Redux mechanical overrides for canonical/main-series Abilities without altering the frozen MR08 canonical registry until merge.

entries.name: Battle Armor
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Critical hits cannot occur against the user, and incoming attack damage is reduced by 20%.
entries.trigger: Continuous during critical-hit and damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: The 20% reduction applies to attack damage while the Ability is active.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds 20% damage reduction to the vanilla critical-hit immunity.

entries.name: Limber
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: The user cannot be paralyzed and takes 30% less crash/recoil-from-miss damage.
entries.trigger: Continuous for paralysis immunity; reduction applies during crash-damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: The added reduction applies to crash damage, not ordinary recoil.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds crash-damage reduction.

entries.name: Color Change
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Before a damaging move hits, the user's type changes to a type that counters that incoming move.
entries.trigger: Immediately before resolving a qualifying incoming damaging move.
entries.restrictions: Uses ER's counter-type selection logic rather than vanilla post-hit matching.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER replaces vanilla post-hit matching with pre-hit counter-typing.

entries.name: Immunity
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: The user cannot be poisoned and takes 50% less damage from Poison-type attacks.
entries.trigger: Continuous during poison legality and incoming Poison-type damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: Poison immunity and Poison-damage reduction are both active.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds 50% Poison-type damage reduction.

entries.name: Shield Dust
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Blocks opponents' damaging-move secondary effects and also prevents damage from entry hazards.
entries.trigger: Continuous during secondary-effect and hazard-damage checks.
entries.restrictions: Does not remove hazards; it prevents their damage to the holder.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds entry-hazard damage immunity.

entries.name: Levitate
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Grants immunity to Ground-type moves and increases the user's Flying-type move damage by 25%.
entries.trigger: Continuous during Ground immunity and Flying damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: Flying boost applies only to the user's Flying-type moves.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds a 25% Flying-type damage boost.

entries.name: Lightning Rod
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Absorbs Electric-type moves; when triggered, raises whichever of Attack or Special Attack is currently higher by 1 stage.
entries.trigger: When targeted by a qualifying Electric-type move.
entries.restrictions: Normal stat-stage caps apply; ties follow the locked ER/Mercury highest-offense routine.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER boosts the higher attacking stat instead of always Special Attack.

entries.name: Illuminate
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: The user's move accuracy is multiplied by 1.2.
entries.trigger: Continuous during accuracy calculation.
entries.restrictions: Field behavior may remain separately supported; this override covers the ER battle effect.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER gives Illuminate a direct 1.2x battle-accuracy boost.

entries.name: Inner Focus
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Prevents flinching and raises Focus Blast's accuracy to 90%.
entries.trigger: Continuous; Focus Blast modifier applies during accuracy calculation.
entries.restrictions: The accuracy change applies specifically to Focus Blast.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds a Focus Blast accuracy buff.

entries.name: Magma Armor
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Prevents freezing and reduces incoming Water- and Ice-type attack damage by 30%.
entries.trigger: Continuous during status and incoming damage checks.
entries.restrictions: Only Water- and Ice-type attack damage receives the reduction.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds 30% Water/Ice damage reduction.

entries.name: Water Veil
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Prevents burn and automatically applies Aqua Ring on entry, restoring 1/8 max HP each turn.
entries.trigger: On entry for Aqua Ring; burn immunity is continuous.
entries.restrictions: Aqua Ring follows the locked ER/Mercury persistent-heal rules.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds automatic Aqua Ring on entry.

entries.name: Run Away
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Guarantees escape from wild battles and raises Speed by 2 stages when one of the user's stats is lowered.
entries.trigger: After a successful stat-stage reduction affects the user.
entries.restrictions: Normal Speed stat-stage cap applies.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds a sharply raised Speed response to stat drops.

entries.name: Keen Eye
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Prevents the user's accuracy from being lowered and multiplies its move accuracy by 1.2.
entries.trigger: Continuous during accuracy-stage and move-accuracy checks.
entries.restrictions: Accuracy-stage immunity and the 1.2x multiplier coexist.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds a 20% accuracy boost.

entries.name: Hyper Cutter
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Prevents Attack reduction and gives the user's contact moves +1 critical-hit stage.
entries.trigger: Continuous during Attack-drop and critical-hit checks.
entries.restrictions: The critical boost applies only to contact moves.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds +1 crit stage to contact moves.

entries.name: Pickup
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Removes entry hazards on the user's side when it enters battle, while retaining Pickup item behavior.
entries.trigger: On switch-in for hazard removal; item pickup uses its normal hooks.
entries.restrictions: Hazard removal follows the locked ER/Mercury side-cleanup rules.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds hazard removal on entry.

entries.name: Hustle
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Multiplies Attack by 1.4 and move accuracy by 0.9.
entries.trigger: Continuous during Attack and accuracy calculation.
entries.restrictions: Uses ER's 40% Attack boost and 10% accuracy penalty.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER changes Hustle from the main-series 1.5x/0.8x profile to 1.4x/0.9x.

entries.name: Overgrow
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Grass-type moves deal 20% more damage normally and 50% more damage at or below 1/3 max HP.
entries.trigger: During Grass-type damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: The 50% low-HP boost replaces, rather than stacks with, the 20% base boost.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER makes the starter ability always active at +20%, upgrading to +50% in a pinch.

entries.name: Blaze
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)

entries.trigger: During Fire-type damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: The 50% low-HP boost replaces, rather than stacks with, the 20% base boost.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER makes the starter ability always active at +20%, upgrading to +50% in a pinch.

entries.exact_effect: Water-type moves deal 20% more damage normally and 50% more damage at or below 1/3 max HP.
entries.trigger: During Water-type damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: The 50% low-HP boost replaces, rather than stacks with, the 20% base boost.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER makes the starter ability always active at +20%, upgrading to +50% in a pinch.

entries.name: Swarm

entries.exact_effect: Bug-type moves deal 20% more damage normally and 50% more damage at or below 1/3 max HP.
entries.trigger: During Bug-type damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: The 50% low-HP boost replaces, rather than stacks with, the 20% base boost.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER makes Swarm always active at +20%, upgrading to +50% in a pinch.

entries.name: Shell Armor
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Critical hits cannot occur against the user, and incoming attack damage is reduced by 20%.
entries.trigger: Continuous during critical-hit and damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: The 20% reduction applies to attack damage while active.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds 20% damage reduction.

entries.name: Anger Point
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: When hit by an opposing physical move, Attack rises by 1 stage; if that physical hit is a critical hit, Attack is maximized instead.
entries.trigger: After qualifying physical hits.
entries.restrictions: Only opposing physical moves trigger it; normal stat-stage caps apply.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds +1 Attack on ordinary physical hits while retaining/maximizing the crit response.

entries.name: Iron Fist
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Punching moves used by the user deal 30% more damage.
entries.trigger: During damage calculation for punching moves.
entries.restrictions: Only punching-class moves qualify.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER uses a 30% boost.

entries.name: Solar Power
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: While sunlight is active, the user's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 with no end-turn HP loss.
entries.trigger: Continuous while sun is active.
entries.restrictions: ER removes Solar Power's normal sun recoil.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER removes the HP-loss drawback.

entries.name: Normalize
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: The user's moves become Normal-type and receive a 10% power boost.
entries.trigger: When the user selects/uses a move.
entries.restrictions: Applies through the ER Normalize type-conversion path.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER uses a 10% power boost.

entries.name: Filter
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Damage from super-effective attacks is reduced by 35%.
entries.trigger: During incoming super-effective damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: Uses ER's 35% reduction.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER strengthens the reduction from the standard 25% to 35%.

entries.name: Solid Rock
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Damage from super-effective attacks is reduced by 35%.
entries.trigger: During incoming super-effective damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: Uses ER's 35% reduction.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER strengthens the reduction from the standard 25% to 35%.

entries.name: Ice Body
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: While hail/icy weather is active, restores 1/8 of max HP at end of turn.
entries.trigger: At end of turn during hail/icy weather.
entries.restrictions: Healing cannot exceed max HP.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER doubles the usual healing rate to 1/8.

entries.name: Bad Dreams
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Each sleeping opposing active Pokémon loses 1/4 max HP at end of turn.
entries.trigger: At end of turn while an opposing Pokémon is asleep.
entries.restrictions: Applies only to sleeping opponents.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER doubles Bad Dreams residual damage to 1/4.

entries.name: Unnerve
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot consume Berries or use healing moves.
entries.trigger: Continuous while the user is active.
entries.restrictions: Does not block Leech Seed, draining moves, or healing-item effects under the ER source comment.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER expands Unnerve beyond Berry prevention to healing moves.

entries.name: Defeatist
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Attack and Special Attack are halved only while the user is at or below 1/3 max HP.
entries.trigger: Continuous at the HP threshold.
entries.restrictions: ER uses a 1/3 threshold instead of 1/2.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER lowers the activation threshold to 1/3 HP.

entries.name: Weak Armor
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: When hit by a physical attack, Defense and Special Defense fall by 1 stage while Attack, Special Attack, and Speed each rise sharply.
entries.trigger: After a qualifying physical hit.
entries.restrictions: Normal stat-stage caps apply.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER substantially expands the stat shifts beyond vanilla Weak Armor.

entries.name: Toxic Boost
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: While poisoned, Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the user takes no poison-status damage.
entries.trigger: Continuous while poisoned.
entries.restrictions: Poison can still be present; its residual HP damage is suppressed.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds immunity to poison residual damage.

entries.name: Flare Boost
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: While burned, Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the user takes no burn-status damage.
entries.trigger: Continuous while burned.
entries.restrictions: Burn can still be present; its residual HP damage is suppressed.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds immunity to burn residual damage.

entries.name: Overcoat
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Protects from sand, hail, and powder effects and reduces incoming special attack damage by 20%.
entries.trigger: Continuous during weather/powder and special-damage checks.
entries.restrictions: The 20% reduction applies to direct special-category attacks.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds 20% special damage reduction.

entries.name: Poison Touch
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Contact attacks have a 30% chance to badly poison the target.
entries.trigger: After a successful contact hit.
entries.restrictions: Normal toxic-poison immunities apply.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER upgrades the inflicted status from regular poison to badly poisoned.

entries.name: Big Pecks
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Contact moves used by the user deal 30% more damage.
entries.trigger: During damage calculation for contact moves.
entries.restrictions: Only contact moves qualify.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER replaces the vanilla Defense-drop immunity with a contact-damage boost.

entries.name: Illusion
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: While the user's Illusion is intact, its damaging moves deal 30% more damage.
entries.trigger: During outgoing damage calculation while Illusion mode is active.
entries.restrictions: The boost ends when Illusion ends.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds a 30% damage boost while disguised.

entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Grass-type moves are absorbed; when triggered, raises whichever of Attack or Special Attack is currently higher by 1 stage.
entries.trigger: When targeted by a qualifying Grass-type move.
entries.restrictions: Normal stat-stage caps apply; ties follow the locked highest-offense routine.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER boosts the higher attacking stat instead of always Attack.

entries.name: Zen Mode
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Darmanitan enters Zen Mode immediately on switch-in, regardless of HP.
entries.trigger: On switch-in / form check.
entries.restrictions: Applies to compatible Darmanitan forms only.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER removes the low-HP requirement.

entries.name: Strong Jaw
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Biting moves receive the ER Strong Jaw boost, with the qualifying set expanded to include Bug Bite, Super Fang, Deathroll, and other locked ER bite-class moves.
entries.trigger: During damage calculation for biting moves.
entries.restrictions: Uses Mercury's ER-derived biting move classification.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER expands the set of moves treated as biting moves.

entries.name: Mega Launcher
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Beam, pump, cannon, bazooka, shot, gun, aura, and pulse moves deal 50% more damage.
entries.trigger: During damage calculation for qualifying launcher moves.
entries.restrictions: Uses Mercury's ER-derived launcher classification.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER expands Mega Launcher well beyond the vanilla aura/pulse subset.

entries.name: Stamina
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: When hit by an attack, Defense rises by 1 stage; if the hit is a critical hit, Defense is maximized instead.
entries.trigger: After a qualifying hit.
entries.restrictions: Normal stat-stage caps apply.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds a critical-hit clause that maximizes Defense.

entries.name: Water Compaction
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: When hit by a Water-type move, Defense rises by 2 stages and the Water-type damage taken is halved.
entries.trigger: During/after a qualifying Water-type hit.
entries.restrictions: Normal Defense stage cap applies.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds 50% Water-type damage reduction.

entries.name: Merciless
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: The user's attacks are guaranteed critical hits against poisoned targets or targets whose Speed stage is -1 or lower.
entries.trigger: During critical-hit calculation.
entries.restrictions: Either condition qualifies.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds the lowered-Speed condition.

entries.name: Long Reach
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: The user's moves do not make contact; physical moves that were already naturally non-contact deal 20% more damage.
entries.trigger: During contact-flag and damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: The 20% boost applies only to physical moves that were non-contact before Long Reach is applied.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds a 20% boost to naturally non-contact physical moves.

entries.name: Liquid Voice
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Sound-based moves become Water-type and deal 20% more damage.
entries.trigger: When using a sound-based move.
entries.restrictions: Only sound-class moves qualify.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds a 20% power boost.

entries.name: Triage
entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Healing moves used by the user gain +1 priority.
entries.trigger: During priority calculation for healing moves.
entries.restrictions: Uses ER's +1 priority value.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER uses +1 priority rather than the main-series +3.

entries.name: Corrosion

entries.trigger: During poison legality and Poison-versus-Steel effectiveness checks.
entries.restrictions: The super-effective override applies specifically to Poison-type moves versus Steel-type targets.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER adds offensive type-effectiveness bypass against Steel.

entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Dark-type moves used by all active Pokémon deal 50% more damage.
entries.trigger: Continuous during Dark-type damage calculation.
entries.restrictions: Applies field-wide under standard Aura interaction rules.
entries.change_from_mainline: ER uses a 50% boost.

entries.source: Elite Redux abilities.h (current master / v2.65-beta-era mechanics reference)
entries.override_scope: Elite Redux modification of a canonical/main-series Ability
entries.exact_effect: Fairy-type moves used by all active Pokémon deal 50% more damage.
